compose:
services:
  db:
    image: '${CONFIGSENTINEL_DB_IMAGE:?reviewed database digest required}'
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: configsentinel
      POSTGRES_USER: configsentinel
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: '${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?required}'
    volumes:
      - 'postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    networks:
      - database
    mem_limit: 256m
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -U configsentinel -d configsentinel'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 15
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=false
      - coolify.managed=true
      - coolify.applicationUuid=configsentinel-prechecks-5a04dd888b
      - coolify.type=application
    pull_policy: never
  migrate:
    image: '${CONFIGSENTINEL_MIGRATION_IMAGE:?reviewed migration digest required}'
    command:
      - /app/server
      - '--migrate'
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: 'postgresql://configsentinel_migrator:${MIGRATOR_DB_PASSWORD}@db:5432/configsentinel?sslmode=disable'
      PUBLIC_URL: 'https://configsentinel-dev.franklem.uk'
      COOKIE_SECURE: 'true'
    networks:
      - database
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    read_only: true
    security_opt:
      - 'no-new-privileges:true'
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=false
      - coolify.managed=true
      - coolify.applicationUuid=configsentinel-prechecks-5a04dd888b
      - coolify.type=application
    pull_policy: never
    restart: 'no'
  api:
    image: '${CONFIGSENTINEL_API_IMAGE:?reviewed api digest required}'
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: 'postgresql://configsentinel_runtime:${RUNTIME_DB_PASSWORD}@db:5432/configsentinel?sslmode=disable'
      PUBLIC_URL: 'https://configsentinel-dev.franklem.uk'
      COOKIE_SECURE: 'true'
    networks:
      - database
      - app
    mem_limit: 384m
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-q'
        - '-O'
        - /dev/null
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/health/ready'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 15
    read_only: true
    security_opt:
      - 'no-new-privileges:true'
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=false
      - coolify.managed=true
      - coolify.applicationUuid=configsentinel-prechecks-5a04dd888b
      - coolify.type=application
    pull_policy: never
  web:
    image: '${CONFIGSENTINEL_WEB_IMAGE:?reviewed web digest required}'
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - app
      - coolify
    mem_limit: 96m
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-q'
        - '-O'
        - /dev/null
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 15
    security_opt:
      - 'no-new-privileges:true'
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.docker.network=coolify
      - traefik.http.routers.configsentinel-dev-http.rule=Host(`configsentinel-dev.franklem.uk`)
      - traefik.http.routers.configsentinel-dev-http.entrypoints=http
      - traefik.http.routers.configsentinel-dev-http.middlewares=redirect-to-https@docker
      - traefik.http.routers.configsentinel-dev.rule=Host(`configsentinel-dev.franklem.uk`)
      - traefik.http.routers.configsentinel-dev.entrypoints=https
      - traefik.http.routers.configsentinel-dev.tls=true
      - traefik.http.routers.configsentinel-dev.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.configsentinel-dev.service=configsentinel-dev
      - traefik.http.services.configsentinel-dev.loadbalancer.server.port=8080
      - coolify.managed=true
      - coolify.applicationUuid=configsentinel-prechecks-5a04dd888b
      - coolify.type=application
    pull_policy: never
networks:
  database:
    external: true
    name: oi6lvzwzomwtbbgzf5uzofuh_database
  app:
    external: true
    name: oi6lvzwzomwtbbgzf5uzofuh_app
  coolify:
    external: true
    name: coolify
volumes:
  postgres_data:
    external: true
    name: oi6lvzwzomwtbbgzf5uzofuh_postgres_data
